# Lit chase-light bulbs, set B (every other bulb), unlit yellow. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Bulb --base-color 1.0000 0.9255 0.4275 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.9255 0.4275
add mesh ico-sphere --name B1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location -1.600 1.030 3.320
add mesh ico-sphere --name B3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location -0.800 1.030 3.320
add mesh ico-sphere --name B5 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location 0.000 1.030 3.320
add mesh ico-sphere --name B7 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location 0.800 1.030 3.320
add mesh ico-sphere --name B9 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location 1.600 1.030 3.320
add mesh ico-sphere --name B11 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location -2.080 1.030 0.900
add mesh ico-sphere --name B13 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location -2.080 1.030 1.700
add mesh ico-sphere --name B15 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location -2.080 1.030 2.500
add mesh ico-sphere --name B17 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location 2.080 1.030 0.900
add mesh ico-sphere --name B19 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location 2.080 1.030 1.700
add mesh ico-sphere --name B21 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.095 --location 2.080 1.030 2.500
select B1 B3 B5 B7 B9 B11 B13 B15 B17 B19 B21
active B1
join
material assign Bulb
shade flat
export bulbs_b.glb
